14892: Rosemarie Braddock DeWitt (born October 26, 1971) is an American actress. DeWitt played Emily Lehman in the Fox television series Standoff (2006–07), co-starring with her future husband Ron Livingston, as well as Charmaine Craine on United States of Tara. She also was the title character in 2008's Rachel Getting Married, garnering several awards and nominations for best supporting actress. She starred in the horror/thriller Poltergeist (2015), a remake of the 1982 film of the same name.
Flushing, Queens, New York City, New York, USA
16940:
Jeremy John Irons (born 19 September 1948) is an English actor and activist. After receiving classical training at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, Irons began his acting career on stage in 1969 and has appeared in many West End theatre productions, including the Shakespeare plays The Winter's Tale, Macbeth, Much Ado About Nothing, The Taming of the Shrew and Richard II. In 1984, he made his Broadway debut in Tom Stoppard's The Real Thing, receiving the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play.

Irons's break-out role came in the ITV series Brideshead Revisited (1981) and is frequently ranked among the greatest British television dramas as well as greatest literary adaptations.
Cowes, Isle of Wight, England, UK
37932:
Felix Gary Gray (born July 17, 1969) is an American director and producer. Gray began his career as a director on numerous critically acclaimed and award-winning music videos, including "It Was a Good Day" by Ice Cube, "Natural Born Killaz" by Dr. Dre and Ice Cube, "Keep Their Heads Ringin'" by Dr. Dre, "Waterfalls" by TLC, and "Ms. Jackson" by Outkast.

Gray made his feature-film directorial debut with the comedy Friday (1995). He has since directed the films Set It Off (1996), The Negotiator (1998), The Italian Job (2003), Be Cool (2005), Law Abiding Citizen (2009), and Straight Outta Compton (2015).
New York City, New York, USA
82732:
Mohanlal Vishwanathan Nair known mononymously as Mohanlal is an Indian actor, producer and singer who is well known for his versatile and natural acting in Indian cinema. He made his acting debut in the unreleased movie Thiranottam (1978), which was followed by a role as the lead antagonist in his first release Manjil Virinja Pookkal in 1980, his onscreen debut.

Antagonistic parts in several movies followed before Mohanlal established himself as a lead actor playing a wide variety of character types in comedy and action films amongst others. He was labelled a superstar of Malayalam cinema in 1986 after the success of Rajavinte Makan, in which he played an underworld don.

86060:
Shilpa Shetty Kundra (born Ashwini Shetty, 8 June 1975) is an Indian film actress and model. Since making her debut in the film Baazigar (1993), she has appeared in nearly 40 Bollywood, Tamil, and Kannada films, her first leading role being in the 1994 Aag. Although she has been through years of decline during her career, Shetty has been willing to reinvent herself quite often. Her performances in Dhadkan (2000) and Rishtey (2002) were appreciated, while her portrayal of an AIDS patient in Phir Milenge (2004) won her many accolades. Her younger sister Shamita Shetty is also a Bollywood film actress.

Shetty has been embroiled in various controversies including suspected mafia links.
93996: Jang Young-nam (장영남) is a South Korean actress. She was born on November 25, 1973.
123180: Raveena Tandon (born 26 October 1974) is an Indian actress, model and producer who works in Hindi films. She is the daughter of director Ravi Tandon, and was born and raised in Mumbai. She started her career in modelling and later made her acting debut in the 1991 action film Patthar Ke Phool, which won her the Filmfare Award for New Face of the Year.
237612:
Namitha (born May 10, 1981) is an Indian actress who works primarily in Tamil and Telugu cinema, alongside appearances in Kannada, Malayalam, and Hindi films.

She entered the entertainment industry after competing in pageantry, finishing as the third runner-up at Femina Miss India 2001. She made her acting debut in Telugu cinema in 2002 with Sontham and Gemeni. Her subsequent Telugu appearances included Oka Raju Oka Rani (2003) and Oka Radha Iddaru Krishnula Pelli (2003).

In 2004, she made her Tamil film debut in Engal Anna, followed by Aai (2004) and Maha Nadigan (2004).
1057068: Han Ye-ri is a South Korean film and television actress.
2085676: Mainak Bhaumik (born 15 January) is a Bengali film director and editor, whose directorial debut Aamra (2006) was a moderate success. After a gap of six years, he directed the 2012 film Bedroom, followed by Maach Mishti & More, Ami Aar Amar Girlfriends and Family Album. In 2014, he had written and directed the drama movie Take One. His 2017 directorial venture includes the comedy-drama Bibaho Diaries starring Ritwick Chakraborty, Sohini Sarkar and Biswanath Basu. His 2018 projects include Ghare & Baire, Crisscross and Generation Ami. His 2019 releases include Bhoot Chaturdashi and Bornoporichoy. His 2022 releases include Kuler Achaar.
